method.topics: Per riksmöte and party: debates spoken in, utterances (speeches and replies) and utterances per issue area, a debate's utterances split evenly over its areas. The area comes from the committee that prepared the decision, or from words in the debate's title.
method.terms: Per riksmöte and party: Snowball stems without stop words or names, the party's 1,200 most used (at least 3 times), and every kept stem's count over all parties.
